hints.text: The $2x$ outside hands a snack to BOTH terms inside.

explanation: $2x \times 3x = 6x^2$ — the coefficients multiply and $x \times x = x^2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Area picture
steps: Draw a rectangle 2x tall and (3x + 4) wide, cut into two patches.
Left patch: 2x by 3x, area 6x². Right patch: 2x by 4, area 8x.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test a value
steps: The answer gives 6 + 8 = 14 — same number, so the distribution worked.
